entries.hit: Choose Local for a solution-specific tool or Global for a system-wide tool. Auto picks Local when available, otherwise Global. Tools are lightweight compared to a full PowerShell installation, and the IDE can validate the selected PowerShell tool and assist when action is needed.
Older PowerShell versions may not be fully compatible. PowerShell 5.1 or later is recommended.
